connectionSpecification.description: Reads every table of the Airtable bases a personal access token can see, one stream per table.

base_ids.description: Bases to sync, by the id in the base URL (appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). Empty syncs every base the token can see.
base_ids.title: Base IDs

personal_access_token.description: Airtable personal access token (https://airtable.com/create/tokens) with the scopes data.records:read and schema.bases:read and access to the bases to sync. It is sent in the Authorization header.
personal_access_token.title: Personal Access Token
